source_snapshot.gpt_v2: Requires topology, a safe consuming transaction, decoded severity policy, exact AER oracle and recovery.

old_problem: One hardcoded BDF pair cannot cover PCIe slot 1~N, and the source omits the disposable poison-consuming transaction, exact AER source/severity oracle, timeout and recovery boundary.
disposition_reason: PCIe AER Poisoned TLP and non-fatal containment have established test semantics. ED-23 permits slot/BDF, device class, disposable transaction and timeout as signed runtime inputs; ED-03 forbids guessing proprietary errortype6, so execution requires the approved AMD package. The review can define complete endpoint/root-port checkpoints, evidence and recovery without retaining a decision or authorizing injection.
decision_basis: Read Reliability row57, AI fields, historical record2458, adjacent CE/OCP cases and next pending row58.
Preserved every slot plus separate endpoint and upstream-root-port Poisoned-TLP checkpoints.
Required one bounded disposable consuming transaction and exact AER Poisoned TLP source/severity evidence.
Defined non-fatal as no fatal/DPC/SyncFlood/host-reset escalation, not as no workload impact.
No configuration change, transaction, injection, reset or DUT test occurred.

test_case.test_name: Parameterized PCIe endpoint/root-port Poisoned-TLP non-fatal containment
test_case.purpose: For each required PCIe slot, prove separately that endpoint and upstream-root-port Poisoned-TLP stimuli reach an approved disposable consumer, are attributed as uncorrectable non-fatal AER events, and recover without fatal platform escalation.
required_package: Approved AMD tool/spec proving errortype6 source semantics
Signed slot/serial/endpoint/upstream-port BDF and dependency map
Disposable bounded transaction and expected consumer outcome
Supported OS, timeout, OOB and device/link recovery runbook
test_case.test_command: For one mapped slot and one source position, capture topology, AER/severity/link/driver state; quiesce dependencies and start the approved disposable transaction; run the vendor-signed errortype6 command against the verified endpoint or upstream port; collect Poisoned-TLP status, source/requester identity, transaction result and recovery; clear stimulus and restore/diff all settings before the separate source or next slot.
test_case.expected_result: The intended source records the documented Poisoned-TLP uncorrectable non-fatal status within timeout; the bounded transaction has the approved failure/completion outcome; no fatal/DPC/SyncFlood/host reset occurs; device, driver and link return healthy after cleanup.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires per-slot topology, vendor transcript, exact AER status/source/severity, consumer outcome, no fatal escalation, post-health and restoration. Tool PASS, an unconsumed poison, generic log, wrong source, production-data exposure, reset or persistent device/link fault fails.
safety_gate: Dedicated SUT and independent OOB; no production, boot, management or irreplaceable data path.
One verified BDF, source and disposable transaction at a time.
Abort on wrong source, fatal/DPC/SyncFlood, unplanned reset, driver/link loss or error storm.
No automatic retry; preserve evidence before recovery.
expected_evidence: Transaction, device and link recovery evidence
Restored state and engineer verdict per checkpoint
test_case.recovery: Stop the workload/injector, retain AER and transaction evidence, restore saved AER/severity/SyncFlood/HDT/BIOS state, recover the device only through the approved driver/link/OOB procedure, verify topology and health, and never retry automatically.

source_conflict.reason: The signed topology, poison consumer and decoded non-fatal oracle replace the hardcoded incomplete procedure without reducing slot coverage.

blocked.reason: Runtime bindings and authorization gate execution; standard AER semantics support a complete parameterized review.
